content.rendered:
Three years ago, singer-songwriter Trace Jory caught X Ambassadors in concert, and he was particularly enthralled by their cover of a Bruce Springsteen song he’d never heard before.

Rather than imitate the band’s cover arrangement, Jory sought out and determined to learn the original, and he posted a work in progress to his Facebook page.

Two years and a week later, in the early days of quarantine, Jory posted a completed take of “Stolen Car” to his YouTube page, and I gotta say: he nailed it.

Performed solo on piano, Jory deeply connects to Bruce’s lyrics. The arrangement may be traditional, but his performance is powerful. His cover of “Stolen Car” ranks among the best I’ve heard.

© June 16, 2021

excerpt.rendered: Trace Jory was introduced to “Stolen Car” through X Ambassador’s creative cover, but he drew on Bruce’s original arrangement for his own rendition.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Lizanne Knott: Stolen Car
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Lizanne Knott celebrated Bruce's 60th birthday by recording a wistful cover of deep cut "Stolen Car."

jetpack-related-posts.title: X Ambassadors: Stolen Car
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: From March 2018, the X Ambassadors prove their fandom by delivering a fantastic, moody cover of Bruce's "Stolen Car."

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, My Morning Jacket: Hungry Heart
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: My Morning Jacket delivered a faithful cover of “Hungry Heart” at their New Year’s Eve concert in 2012.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, Dave Alvin: Seeds
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: As far as I'm concerned, Dave Alvin's cover of "Seeds" is the definitive version of the song.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Little White Lies
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: "Little White Lies" is a thematic analogue to "Stolen Car" and forerunner to "Brilliant Disguise" -- a fascinating outtake from The River sessions.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, Mary G: Further On (Up the Road)
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Mary G's version of "Further On (Up the Road)" is a cover of a cover, but it stands on its own as a fresh, wonderful take on Bruce's song.
